checklist.evidence: Diagnosis blames Deployment/vigil-app, while ground truth identifies node vigil-worker-1 as the fault origin.
Diagnosis treats vigil-app readiness and backend timeouts as root cause rather than identifying vigil-worker-1 sysctl drift.
Deployment/vigil-app is incorrectly identified as the fault origin instead of vigil-worker-1.
Diagnosis describes nginx upstream timeouts and readiness failure, not runtime net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range sysctl drift.
No sysctl key, narrowed value 32000 32003, restore value, or target host is mentioned.
Fault is attributed to an nginx proxy/backend timeout, an unrelated mechanism to the injected sysctl drift.
Diagnosis blames vigil-app, nginx, and app-backend, none identified as fault contributors in ground truth.
The required affected component, vigil-worker-1, is entirely absent from the diagnosis.
Readiness probe and upstream timeout symptoms do not describe port-range narrowing on vigil-worker-1 under stepped load.
